records.body:

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Ventures* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project and no key milestone despite onboarding email [email:e719a522]; no reply from Leo, no tickets, so no evidence of active engagement. One invite sent shows some intent, but 8 days left with zero product progress makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Quartz Ventures project up
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for getting started with Wrenfield -- I see you've already sent an invite to a teammate, which is a great first step.

The next one is usually the first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm happy to walk it with you.

Would a short call this week work? I can also answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
